zones.label: Read the Situation
zones.summary: Assess safety, power, escalation, exits, and whether dialogue is appropriate.
facts: Not every conflict should be mediated.
Immediate danger requires distance and help.

zones.label: Lower the Heat
zones.summary: Use calmer tone, more space, fewer spectators, and a pause when possible.
facts: Do not use de-escalation to tolerate abuse.

zones.label: Listen for Needs
zones.summary: Listen for interests, fears, values, and unmet needs beneath positions.
facts: Each person deserves a chance to speak when safe.

zones.label: Create Options
zones.summary: Generate choices that protect safety, dignity, and practical needs.

zones.label: Exit or Get Help
zones.summary: Leave, set a boundary, or involve trusted adults, staff, or emergency help when unsafe.
facts: You are not required to solve every conflict.
